P1_transport_adjudication.rule: frozen denominator_rule implemented verbatim: 'Transport failure mid-BUILD: journal + re-queue, consumes no attempt (addendum-2 discipline: ambiguity is NOT censored; the archived capture decides)'
P1_transport_adjudication.mechanism: adjudicateTransportFailure() reads ONLY the archived capture: >=1 provider error record, ZERO integrity failures/STOPs, EVERY error record matching an unambiguous transport class (undici 'fetch failed'; 'LLM API request failed: 5xx/408/429' per the frozen llm-provider error shape; ECONNRESET/ETIMEDOUT/UND_ERR_*/socket-hang-up codes), AND the capture ENDING on the transport error (terminal-position rule). Verdict TRANSPORT-REQUEUE -> journaled re-queue, no slot consumed. AMBIGUOUS/NOT-TRANSPORT -> evaluable MODEL-FAILURE (never censored).
P1_transport_adjudication.scope_guard: MAX_REQUEUES = 3 hard cap: after MAX_REQUEUES non-consuming re-queues the campaign STOPs (REQUEUE-EXHAUSTED) and returns to the operator. Evaluable <= 3 and total attempts <= 6; retries can never silently exceed the approved scope.
P1_transport_adjudication.qualified: T1 (fetch failed re-queued, NO slot consumed, campaign completes on the re-queued attempt), T2 (HTTP 400 stays evaluable MODEL-FAILURE), T3 (adjudicator matrix: 6 qualifying classes incl. 502/408/429/ECONNRESET/socket-hang-up; 400/app-error/mixed/tampered ambiguous; terminal-position rule), T4 (REQUEUE-EXHAUSTED cap, nothing consumed)

P1_durable_evidence.per_attempt_package: archiveAttemptEvidence() runs BEFORE the attempt is counted and BEFORE the next buildFixture() destroys .sle; immutable package per attempt: guard-capture.jsonl, db-records.json (run row, artifacts incl. submissions/anchors/applied-edit provenance, decisions), run-artifacts.tgz (staging + composition evidence), attempt-outcome.json (publication outcome + diagnostics + adjudication), sealed by evidence-manifest.json (per-file sha256 + package_sha256) and SELF-VERIFIED; a publication without runtime artifacts fails closed; any packaging failure = G2 STOP
P1_durable_evidence.campaign_ledger: campaign-ledger.jsonl (outside .sle) written BEFORE the next attempt: preflight verdict, per-attempt classification with package hash, transport-requeue events (operator-visible per the frozen rule), slot assignments, terminal state
P1_durable_evidence.preflight: the GO-time probe capture is durably archived OUTSIDE .sle (preflight/preflight-guard.jsonl + preflight-record.json with sha256) and adjudicated by adjudicatePreflightCapture(): exactly one guarded request+response, zero STOPs/integrity failures, stop_reason end_turn AND finish_reason in {stop, end_turn} — the P2 transport-censoring class (finish_reason error/length/absent with partial content) is REJECTED
